items.title: Risk of Idiopathic Intracranial Hypertension Following Anemia in Young Adults: A Retrospective Cohort TriNetX Database Study.
items.abstract: Anemia has been associated with idiopathic intracranial hypertension (IIH) in small studies, but whether severity modulates IIH risk remains unclear. This study evaluated the hazard of incident IIH after mild, moderate, and severe anemia in young adults. Using the TriNetX Research Network (111) health care organizations), adults aged 18-50 years with persistent anemia (≥2 hemoglobin values) were stratified as mild (11.0-12.9 g/dL), moderate (8.0-10.9 g/dL), or severe (<8.0 g/dL) and matched 1:1 to controls (Hb ≥ 13.0 g/dL) by propensity score matching on demographics, body mass index, comorbidities, and socioeconomic factors. The primary outcome was incident IIH; Cox proportional hazards models estimated hazard ratios (HRs) at 6 months, 1 year, and 3 years. Sensitivity analyses applied the World Health Organization (WHO) women's mild threshold and compared patients with vs without iron supplementation. After matching, 1,240,670 mild anemia patients (mean age 29.0 ± 8.7 years, 83.4% female), 666,515 moderate (29.7 ± 8.1, 86.3% female), and 114,785 severe (31.0 ± 8.9, 75.4% female) were compared with equal-sized control cohorts. Hazard of incident IIH was elevated at every severity and time interval. At 6 months, HRs were 1.45 (95% CI 1.29-1.63), 1.61 (1.39-1.86), and 2.53 (1.82-3.52) for mild, moderate, and severe anemia. At 1 year, HRs were 1.35 (1.22-1.49), 1.33 (1.17-1.51), and 1.94 (1.46-2.58). At 3 years, HRs were 1.17 (1.08-1.26), 1.15 (1.04-1.27), and 1.40 (1.11-1.76); all estimates remained significantly elevated, although CIs overlapped across severity bands. The WHO women's threshold sensitivity yielded concordant, modestly stronger estimates (6 months: HR 1.99 [1.73-2.30]; 3 years: 1.43 [1.31-1.58]). Iron supplementation was associated with reduced IIH hazard (HR 0.75, 95% CI 0.62-0.93; n = 340,660 per group). Anemia is associated with elevated hazard of incident IIH in young adults across all severity bands. Point estimates were higher with greater anemia severity and at earlier follow-up, but CIs overlapped across severity bands, so a severity gradient could not be established. Iron supplementation was associated with reduced hazard. Findings are limited by observational design, administrative case identification, and low absolute incidence; anemia represents a potentially modifiable factor warranting evaluation in patients with papilledema.
items.summary_ja:
背景：若年成人における特発性頭蓋内高血圧症（IIH）と貧血の関連は小規模研究で示唆されているが、貧血の重症度がIIHリスクに与える影響は不明であった。  
方法：TriNetXデータベースを用い、18～50歳の持続的貧血患者を軽度（Hb 11.0-12.9 g/dL）、中等度（8.0-10.9 g/dL）、重度（<8.0 g/dL）に分類し、貧血なし（Hb ≥13.0 g/dL）の対照群と1対1で傾向スコアマッチングした。主要評価項目は新規IIH発症で、6か月、1年、3年時点でハザード比（HR）を算出。鉄剤補充の影響も検討した。  
結果：各重症度群の患者数はそれぞれ約124万、67万、11万名で、全ての重症度と期間でIIH発症リスクが有意に上昇。6か月時点のHRは軽度1.45、中等度1.61、重度2.53。鉄剤補充はIIHリスクを有意に低減（HR 0.75）した。  
結論：若年成人の貧血は重症度にかかわらずIIH発症リスクを高め、鉄剤補充がリスク低減に寄与する可能性が示唆された。観察研究の限界はあるが、貧血は視神経乳頭浮腫患者の評価における修正可能な因子と考えられる。
items.summary_short_ja: 若年成人における貧血と特発性頭蓋内高血圧症（IIH）の発症リスクを後ろ向きコホート研究で検討した。軽度から重度の貧血すべてでIIHリスクが有意に上昇し、重症度が高いほどリスクも高い傾向があったが、明確な重症度依存性は示されなかった。鉄剤補充はIIHリスクを低減させる可能性が示唆された。観察研究のため因果関係は不明だが、貧血はIIHの修正可能なリスク因子として注目される。

items.title: Ninety-Day Acute Ischemic Stroke Readmission in People Hospitalized With Migraine With Aura: A National Cohort Study.
items.abstract: Migraine with aura is recognized as a risk factor for acute ischemic stroke (AIS). However, the short-term risk of stroke, particularly within 90 days of hospitalization for migraine, has not been thoroughly evaluated on a national scale. This study aims to address this gap by examining the association between migraine with aura during admission and 90-day AIS readmission. Using the Healthcare Cost and Utilization Project's Nationwide Readmissions Database between 2016 and 2019, we identified patients in the United States who received a diagnosis of migraine during admission, either principal or nonprincipal. The reference group for analysis contained all adult patients admitted during the study period without a principal or nonprincipal diagnosis of migraine. The primary outcome was subsequent admission for AIS within 90 days. Diagnoses were identified using standard and validated ICD-10-CM codes. Three patient groups were delineated: migraine with aura, migraine without aura, and unspecified migraine. Inverse probability of treatment weighting and multivariable Cox regression models were used to assess the risk of AIS across these 3 patient groups, adjusted for risk factors. Among 64,808,935 patients (mean age 56.19 years, 60.0% female) admitted during the study period, 1,257,671 (1.94%) patients were admitted with any migraine diagnosis, of which 78,650 (6.25% of migraine cohort) were admitted with a principal diagnosis of migraine. In total, 75,460 (0.12%) were admitted with migraine with aura. Within 90 days, 272,812 (0.42%) patients were readmitted with AIS. After adjusting for cardiovascular risk factors, migraine with aura was associated with an elevated risk for 90-day AIS (adjusted hazard ratio [aHR] 1.98, 95% CI 1.68-2.35,  Among hospitalized patients, migraine with aura was associated with an increased risk of AIS within 90 days. These findings underscore the importance of careful vascular risk assessment in this population. Future research should investigate the pathomechanisms underlying this association.
items.summary_ja:
背景：片頭痛のうち、前兆（オーラ）を伴うタイプは急性虚血性脳卒中（AIS）のリスク因子とされるが、入院後90日以内の短期リスクは全国規模で十分に検討されていない。  
方法：2016～2019年の米国全国再入院データベースを用い、入院時に片頭痛（前兆あり・なし・不明）と診断された患者群と非片頭痛患者群を比較。主要アウトカムは90日以内のAIS再入院とし、逆確率重み付けと多変量Cox回帰モデルで心血管リスク因子を調整して解析した。  
結果：約6480万人の入院患者中、125万7千人が片頭痛診断を受け、そのうち7万5千人が前兆あり片頭痛。90日以内にAISで再入院した患者は27万2千人。調整後、前兆あり片頭痛患者はAIS再入院リスクが有意に高く（調整ハザード比1.98、95％CI 1.68-2.35）示された。  
結論：入院患者において、前兆を伴う片頭痛は90日以内のAISリスク増加と関連し、血管リスクの慎重な評価が重要である。今後はこの関連の病態解明が求められる。
items.summary_short_ja: 片頭痛の前兆（オーラ）を伴う患者は、入院後90日以内に急性虚血性脳卒中（AIS）で再入院するリスクが約2倍に増加することが、米国の大規模全国コホート研究で明らかになった。64万件超の入院データを解析し、心血管リスクを調整後も有意な関連が認められた。片頭痛オーラ患者の血管リスク評価の重要性が示され、今後は関連機序の解明が求められる。

items.title: Relative Pericentral Tau Distribution in Cerebral Amyloid Angiopathy Compared With Alzheimer Disease.
items.abstract: Differentiating cerebral amyloid angiopathy (CAA) from Alzheimer disease (AD) is essential for prognosis and clinical management. However, pathophysiology-based molecular biomarkers are lacking. Tau deposition may offer discriminative signals: It occurs late in primary cortices including pericentral cortex in AD but may emerge earlier and more diffusely in CAA. We investigated whether a pericentral-predominant pattern of tau deposition distinguishes CAA from AD and characterize its cortical spatial distribution and contributing factors in CAA. We consecutively enrolled healthy controls and patients with CAA and AD with amyloid (18F-florbetapir) and tau (18F-florzolotau) PET. We compared pericentral tau-PET retention (both standardized uptake value ratios [SUVRs] and regional-to-global ratios) between CAA, AD, and controls and identified optimal cutoffs differentiating CAA from AD. We validated the discriminative performance using 18F-flortaucipir tau-PET in an external cohort. We assessed correlates of tau deposition in multivariable regression analyses and analyzed hierarchical patterns of tau involvement using conditional probability analyses in CAA. The derivation cohort included 22 controls, 80 CAA, and 64 AD (mean age 60.1, 68.4, and 66.3 years; 50.0%, 38.8%, and 50.0% female). The validation cohort included 65 CAA and 19 AD (mean age 74.1 and 73.6 years; 53.8% and 68.4% female). Patients with CAA showed higher global and pericentral tau SUVRs compared with controls but lower than AD. However, pericentral-to-global tau ratios were significantly higher in CAA than AD (0.93 ± 0.07 vs 0.82 ± 0.08,  Higher pericentral-to-global tau ratio differentiates CAA from AD and may reflect spatial distribution patterns potentially influenced by both amyloid and vascular pathology.
items.summary_ja:
背景：脳アミロイド血管症（CAA）とアルツハイマー病（AD）は予後や治療方針の違いから鑑別が重要であるが、病態に基づく分子バイオマーカーは不足している。タウ蛋白の沈着はADでは一次皮質の後期に生じるが、CAAではより早期かつ広範に現れる可能性がある。  
方法：健康対照群、CAA患者、AD患者を対象に、アミロイド（18F-florbetapir）およびタウ（18F-florzolotau）PET検査を実施。特に中心周囲皮質のタウ沈着（SUVRおよび局所対全体比）を比較し、CAAとADの鑑別に有効なカットオフ値を設定。外部コホートで18F-flortaucipir PETによる検証も行った。多変量回帰分析や条件付き確率分析でタウ沈着の関連因子と階層的分布を解析。  
結果：CAA患者は対照よりも全体および中心周囲のタウSUVRが高かったが、ADよりは低かった。一方、中心周囲対全体のタウ比率はCAAで有意に高く（0.93±0.07 vs 0.82±0.08）、この比率がCAAとADの鑑別に有用であることが示された。  
結論：中心周囲皮質における相対的なタウ沈着の分布パターンはCAAとADを区別する指標となり、アミロイドおよび血管病変の影響を反映している可能性がある。
items.summary_short_ja: 脳アミロイド血管症（CAA）とアルツハイマー病（AD）の鑑別は重要であるが、分子バイオマーカーは不足している。本研究は、CAAにおける周中心部優位のタウ沈着パターンがADと異なるかをPET検査で検証した。CAAはADよりも周中心部に相対的に多いタウ蓄積を示し、この比率が両疾患の識別に有用であることが示された。タウの空間的分布はアミロイドと血管病変の影響を反映している可能性がある。

items.title: Efficacy and Safety of 2 Rimegepant Dosing Regimens for the Prevention of Episodic Migraine: A Randomized Controlled Study.
items.abstract: Traditional preventive treatments for migraine have limitations (e.g., efficacy, adverse events [AEs], contraindications, and interactions). The aim of this study was to evaluate the efficacy and safety of 2 rimegepant dosing regimens relative to placebo as preventive treatment for episodic migraine. This was a phase 4, randomized, placebo-controlled study. Adults with a ≥1-year history of episodic migraine (with or without aura) and 4-14 migraine attacks/month were enrolled from outpatient/research sites in 10 countries. After a 28-day observation phase, participants were randomly assigned to placebo once daily, rimegepant 75 mg every other day/alternating placebo, or rimegepant 75 mg once daily for 12-weeks of double-blind treatment. The primary end point was mean reduction from the observation phase in monthly migraine days over the entire 12-week double-blind phase analyzed using linear mixed effects modeling. Hierarchical testing was used for key secondary end points to control type I error. Safety assessments included AEs. Participants (n = 692; median age 44.0 years, 86.7% female) were treated double blind with rimegepant every other day (n  Both rimegepant dosing regimens were superior to placebo for the preventive treatment of migraine and were well tolerated. This study demonstrates the efficacy and safety of rimegepant 75 mg QD in a double-blind study. The study was not designed to directly compare the rimegepant EOD and QD dosing regimens. ClinicalTrials.gov NCT05217927 (clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT05217927); registered January 20, 2022; first enrollment March 4, 2022. This study provides Class I evidence that in adults with more than 1-year history of episodic migraine and 4-14 migraine attacks/month, both rimegepant 75 mg every other day and rimegepant 75 mg daily were superior to placebo in reducing monthly migraine days up to 12 weeks of follow-up.
items.summary_ja:
背景：片頭痛の予防治療には効果や副作用、禁忌、薬物相互作用などの課題がある。  
方法：1年以上の片頭痛既往歴があり、月4～14回の発作を持つ成人692名を対象に、28日間の観察後、プラセボ群、リメゲパント75mgを隔日投与群（プラセボと交互）、およびリメゲパント75mgを毎日投与群に無作為割付し、12週間の二重盲検試験を実施。主要評価項目は観察期からの月間片頭痛日数の平均減少量で、線形混合効果モデルで解析。副次評価項目も階層的検定で評価。安全性は有害事象で確認。  
結果：リメゲパントの両投与群はプラセボに比べて月間片頭痛日数の有意な減少を示し、安全性も良好であった。  
結論：リメゲパント75mgの隔日投与および毎日投与は、片頭痛の予防においてプラセボより優れた効果を示し、忍容性も高いことが示された。ただし、両投与法の直接比較は行われていない。
items.summary_short_ja: 本研究は、反復性片頭痛の予防におけるリメゲパント75mgの2つの投与法（1日1回および1日おき投与）の有効性と安全性をプラセボ対照で検証した。12週間の二重盲検試験で、両投与法はプラセボに比べて月間片頭痛日数を有意に減少させ、副作用も良好に管理された。リメゲパントは片頭痛予防に有効かつ安全な治療選択肢であることが示された。
